newsitem.title: USA: Pan Am headquarters will be in Florida.
newsitem.headline: Pan Am headquarters will be in Florida.

text.p: Pan American World Airways said Monday that it would locate its world headquarters in Dade County, Florida, a decision the county said would bring with it more than 600 jobs and more than $25 million in incremental tax revenues during its first 10 years.
The agreement between Pan Am and Dade County provides for an $8.5 million incentive package that includes a combination of loans and grants to Pan Am from the federal, state and county governments.

Among other things, the agreement still requires review and passage of appropriate legislation by the Metro-Dade County Board of County Commissioner and the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, county officials said.

The new Pan Am is the successor to the industry giant and international aviation pioneer that once boasted a fleet of 160 aircraft flying to more international destinations than any of its rivals. But the new company, which flies six planes on five routes, shares only its name and a few executives with the previous airline.

The original Pan Am, once a major employer in and symbol of Miami, collapsed in 1991 under the weight of heavy debt and lawsuits related to the 1988 bombing of Pan Am flight 103 over Lockerbie, Scotland. The company returned to the skies in September.
